audit.whatIsWrong: The last three stages all read 'Skill' while their own whys are unambiguous: whys[4] says Level 6 stays his, whys[5] says first item flips to you, whys[6] says at two items you win the 1v1. The packet also records the chart as contradicting the data.
audit.why: Trundle owns the whole laning phase through 6 (Frozen Domain's attack-speed and healing amp, Pillar of Ice zoning, then Subjugate); the 52.59% Emerald+ win rate is bought back entirely on items.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 6 Trundle, First item and 2+ items Dr. Mundo — matching the packet levelChart. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold Level 6 as Mundo's flip point ('press R mid-fight and regen half your HP') when Level 6 is the single worst moment in the matchup, and Subjugate's cooldown was never given at rank 1.
audit.why: Subjugate 120/100/80, 650 range: it steals a percent of your health, armour and magic resist, and the amount stolen doubles over the following 4 seconds. Against a champion whose entire value is the health bar, that is the opposite of a Mundo spike.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 120s rank-1 cooldown, the percent steal and the 4-second doubling, and tells you to decline the all-in on his Domain.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why claimed 'your passive shrugs the first CC'. Trundle has no immobilizing effect — Chomp and Pillar of Ice are slows and the pillar is terrain — so Goes Where He Pleases is never popped by him in lane. Pillar's real property (impassable terrain, 18s at rank 3) and Frozen Domain's healing amplification were both missing.
audit.why: Riot text: Pillar of Ice becomes impassable terrain and slows; Frozen Domain grants attack speed, move speed and increased healing from all sources; Chomp is a 3.5s auto-reset that saps attack damage. Mundo's Heart Zapper heals only if the recast burst hits, 325 range.
audit.corrected: The passive line is replaced with Pillar's terrain behaviour and cooldown; Frozen Domain's healing amp is now the stated reason to buy Grievous Wounds first; Heart Zapper's 325-range burst condition is written into phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] said to wait for a tank item 'so R Subjugate steals a smaller share of your HP'. Subjugate steals a percentage — the share does not shrink with more health, and Grievous Wounds, not raw stacking, is what actually changes the fight.
audit.why: Subjugate flagged percentHealth; Frozen Domain and King's Tribute both heal him. Anti-heal is the buy that turns off his sustain amp.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and whys[5] now put Grievous Wounds ahead of the HP stack as the thing that flips the item stage.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Subjugate is up.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is 18s at rank 3 and it is terrain — it cannot be walked through. Poke from 975 and never brawl on top of Frozen Domain.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Trundle must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Frozen Domain amplifies healing from all sources, so buy Grievous Wounds before you commit. Heart Zapper heals only if its burst hits inside 325.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Trundle to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Subjugate lands at 6 — 120s at rank 1, and it steals a percent of your health and resists, doubling over 4 seconds. Decline the all-in in his Domain.

edits.before: Level 6 stays his: Subjugate steals your bonus HP and resists while healing him.
edits.after: Level 6 stays his: Subjugate steals health and resists, doubled over 4s.

edits.before: First item flips to you — your HP outgrows R's steal and Q slow catches him.
edits.after: First item flips it — Grievous Wounds guts Frozen Domain's healing amp.

edits.before: Wait for your first tank item so R Subjugate steals a smaller share of your HP
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds before HP — Frozen Domain amplifies every heal he gets

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 — his mistake there is your whole window.

edits.before: Fighting on his terms lets him stack his strengths and flip the trade.
edits.after: Frozen Domain amps all his healing — never brawl standing on it.

notes: Mirror trundle__drmundo already existed and is reused: the Heart Zapper 'burst must hit inside 325 or no heal' rule, the Grievous-Wounds-before-commit order, and the 120s Subjugate number.
